general.title: MOSuite-clean
general.instructions: clean raw counts in a multiOmicsDataSet

parameters.name: Clean up column names
parameters.description: Invalid raw counts column names can cause errors in downstream analysis. If TRUE, invalid column names are automatically altered by adding X to names that begin with a numeral and replacing special characters (-,:. ) with underscores. Invalid sample names and changes made will be reported.

parameters.name: Split gene names
parameters.description: If TRUE, split the gene name column by any of these special characters: ,|_-:

parameters.name: Aggregate duplicate gene names
parameters.description: If a Feature ID is duplicated on multiple rows of the raw counts, the log will report these Feature IDs. When TRUE, counts for duplicate Feature IDs are aggregated into a single row by summing counts across duplicate rows within each sample. Additional identifier columns, if present, are preserved and multiple matching identifiers appear as comma-separated values.
parameters.help_text: When TRUE, additional identifier columns (e.g. Ensembl IDs) are preserved and multiple matching identifiers appear as comma-separated values.

parameters.name: Column for collapsing duplicates
parameters.description: Select the column with Feature IDs to use as grouping elements to collapse the counts matrix. The log output lists columns available to identify duplicate row IDs for aggregation.
parameters.help_text: Leaving this empty uses the Feature ID column. If the Feature ID column can be split, the non-Ensembl ID name will be used. If no Ensembl IDs are detected, split IDs will be named Feature_id_1 and Feature_id_2.

parameters.name: Group column name
parameters.description: Sample metadata column used to color the read-depth plot.
parameters.help_text: Leaving this empty uses one color for all samples.

parameters.name: Colors for read-depth plot
parameters.description: Optional colors used when group_colname is supplied. Named vectors are matched to group values; unnamed vectors follow group order and are extended with MOSuite colors when too few colors are supplied.
parameters.help_text: Use color names or hex codes. Leaving this empty uses stored MOSuite colors.

parameters.name: count type
parameters.description: The type of counts to use. Must be a name in the counts slot, moo@counts.

parameters.name: Sample ID Column Name
parameters.description: The column from the sample metadata containing the sample names. The names in this column must exactly match the names used as sample column names in the input counts matrix.
parameters.help_text: Leaving this empty uses the first column in the sample metadata.

parameters.name: Feature ID column name
parameters.description: The column from the counts data containing the Feature IDs, usually Gene or Protein ID. This is usually the first column of the input counts matrix.
parameters.help_text: Leaving this empty uses the first column in the counts matrix.

parameters.name: Samples to rename
parameters.description: Use this parameter to rename samples manually. Provide mappings in the format old_name: new_name; add each additional sample renaming as another item or comma-separated mapping.
